title: Crayon Miniature World — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea to system on a crayon tabletop
scenes.purpose: Show the Crayon Miniature World characteristic action: establish the closest wax-textured form, truck the miniature-height camera to a second richly marked form, and bring a third form into view by parallax while the idea connects into a system.
visuals: Orange wax-crayon sphere (the idea) with drawn latitude/longitude marks, UV-mapped so marks stick as it rotates
Blue wax-crayon cylinder (the system) with vertical strokes and a pale blue capped top
Purple wax-crayon miniature house entering the right foreground by camera parallax
Green leaf-shaped tabletop receiving soft shadow-map shadows and time-keyed contact-shadow blobs
Red wax connector tube drawn from sphere to cylinder; red nodes and cream links appear on the cylinder
Stationary pale blue-to-mint crayon sky backdrop
Clean white caption sign top-left: 'An idea becomes' / 'a connected system'

beats.development: Close, low camera on the idea sphere; it settles onto the table and its contact shadow tightens and darkens. Caption sign fades in as one unit.
Camera trucks right and back at miniature height; the blue cylinder arrives while the red wax connector draws from the sphere toward it. Sphere keeps rotating so its marks visibly stay attached.
Connector reaches the cylinder; five red nodes pop on in sequence and cream links draw between them. The purple house completes its parallax entry in the right foreground as the camera eases to rest.
Settled hold: all three forms, shadows, the connected system and the caption are static and readable.

findings: Caption sign is fully legible from 0.43 s and stays static through 3.0 s (about 2.5 s of reading time).
All motion ends by 2.45 s, leaving a settled frame before 2.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.5–3.0 s settled hold so the connected system, contact shadows and caption can be read.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects, narration or subtitles.
STYLE.json lists no preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview demonstrates the catalogue characteristic action directly.
Rendered with Three.js (WebGL) driven by one paused GSAP timeline; no Blender used.
Wax crayon texture is a procedural seeded Canvas 2D painting mapped to UVs with a matching bump map, an approximation of physical crayon on paper; no depth-of-field blur on the foreground house.
